text.Machine Base:
How to Play ==
When you play the Machine Base you put into play an Outpost with a defense of 6. And then you draw a card and scrap a card from your hand.
 Strategy ==
The Machine Base puts up an Outpost in play with a defense of 6. Drawing a card is good, but scrapping from your hand is less powerful than getting a choice between your hand and discard pile. Its sheer horror if you have to scrap one of 2 cards you both want to bring into play. And with a cost of 7 trade its an Outpost to buy if all good bases are taken.
